sources.title: Code Général des Impôts (General Tax Code), as amended
sources.institution: Journal Officiel de la République de Côte d'Ivoire / Ministry of Finance
sources.coverage: VAT standard rate (18%); excises; exemptions; zero-rated supplies; import VAT
sources.notes: Consolidated text via official journal. All amendments through June 2026.

sources.title: Tax Administration Guide 2026 (Direction Générale Des Douanes et Impôts)
sources.coverage: VAT procedures; excise rates; customs duties; formalities; electronic filing
sources.notes: Administrative guide for tax procedures. Consolidates VAT, excise, and customs provisions.

sources.title: Finance Law 2026 (Loi de Finances 2026)
sources.coverage: fiscal year 2026 tax rates; special levies; excise tariffs; import duties
sources.notes: Enacted December 2025; effective January 2026. Defines annual tax measures.
